card.text: Earth-sized planet of TRAPPIST-1, one year every 6.10 days.

introduction.text: TRAPPIST-1e is 0.92 Earth radii across and 0.69 Earth masses. It circles its star every 6.10 days at 0.029 au, receiving 0.65 times the sunlight Earth does.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the measured radius, lit by its star. No image, colour or map of this planet exists.
